attempts.text:
This plan rescues the 7 elderly people at Kalika temple and Bidur care home and defers the 11 people at Kakani temple and Suryagadhi school, whom no car can reach.

- **Unreachable:** The bridge from Uttargaya shelter to Kakani temple is washed away. Kakani temple and Suryagadhi school connect only to each other, so no car can reach them. Their 11 people must be deferred: 1 elderly (50), 4 adults (80) and 6 children (360), for 490 in total.
- **Kalika temple:** Kalika temple is not an evacuation point, so its 4 elderly must be driven to Uttargaya shelter. That costs 22 minutes round trip from the shelter, against a deferral penalty of 200, so it is worth doing.
- **Bidur care home:** The 3 elderly there cost 16 minutes round trip from the shelter, against a penalty of 150, so this is also worth doing.
- **Car choice:** car1 handling both trips costs 38 minutes. Sending car2 to Bidur from Thakre hospital instead would cost 30 for that trip alone, 52 in total, so car2 stays put.

Total cost is 38 minutes of driving plus 490 in penalties, which makes 528.

<plan>
drive car1 uttargaya-shelter kalika-temple
load car1 elderly 4
drive car1 kalika-temple uttargaya-shelter
unload car1 elderly 4
drive car1 uttargaya-shelter bidur-care-home
load car1 elderly 3
drive car1 bidur-care-home uttargaya-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
defer kakani-temple elderly 1
defer kakani-temple adult 4
defer suryagadhi-school child 6
</plan>

COST: 528
